patch_description: After chain cooldown forces reorder, check if primary provider (kimi_k2_6_cloud) was displaced from position 0. If so, rebuild new_chain with primary first, preserving all other providers in their reordered positions. This ensures budget is spent on the primary provider first, and fallback only occurs if primary genuinely fails.
patch_justification: Evidence showed that forced reorder moved codex to position 0 and kimi to position 3. With 90s total budget, codex (120s timeout) consumed the budget before kimi was ever attempted. By preserving kimi at position 0, all 6 post-patch probes selected kimi with FAST_SUCCESS and stable latency 2-8s.
risk_assessment: Minimal. Patch only affects behavior during _force_reorder=True (chain cooldown). Does not change normal chain order. Does not affect trading, B8, tools, or other routes. Primary provider remains configurable via PROVIDER_PRIORITY dict.
